name: Fizzle's Claw
summary: In Thunder Ridge, Fizzle Darkstorm’s claw is carried to Razor Hill as proof of his death. The goblin warlock was a dangerous Burning Blade conspirator.

sections.title: A Grim Trophy
sections.body: Orgnil Soulscar sent forces to root out shadow cults threatening the orcish homeland. He identified Fizzle Darkstorm as an instigator spreading corruption in Thunder Ridge. The claw gives Horde commanders proof that the warlock, who operated under the Burning Blade’s banner, has been slain.

sections.title: The Threat in Thunder Ridge
sections.body: Thunder Ridge lies just northwest of Razor Hill, close enough to threaten the surrounding lands. Horde scouts took Fizzle’s claw back to Razor Hill, confirming that his rituals and attempt to establish a Burning Blade foothold had been stopped.

faq.q: Who does this claw belong to?
faq.answer: The claw belonged to Fizzle Darkstorm, a goblin warlock affiliated with the Burning Blade.

faq.q: Why does Orgnil Soulscar want Fizzle's Claw?
faq.answer: Orgnil Soulscar wants proof that Fizzle is dead. The Burning Blade works in secret, and the claw confirms that this threat to Durotar has been removed.
The claw was taken from Fizzle Darkstorm at his camp in Thunder Ridge, northwest of Razor Hill in Durotar.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade doing in Durotar?
aliases: why are cultists in thunder ridge
faq.answer: The Burning Blade seeks to undermine the new orcish homeland through demonic corruption, dark sorcery, and civil unrest. Warlocks like Fizzle establish hidden camps to spread chaos across the region.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, presenting Fizzle’s claw in Razor Hill helps cleanse Durotar of shadow cults that threaten the young nation’s safety.
As a warlock, you know Fizzle Darkstorm used fel arts in service of the Burning Blade, turning his talents against the Horde.
